name: com.pinlyx/messaging-mcp
description: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Telegram inbox for AI assistants on the official APIs.

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
environmentVariables.description: WhatsApp phone number id that sends messages.

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: WhatsApp Business Account id, needed to list templates.

environmentVariables.name: META_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Meta app secret, used to verify webhook signatures.

environmentVariables.name: META_VERIFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token you choose for the Meta webhook subscribe check.

environmentVariables.name: MESSENGER_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Facebook Page access token for Messenger.

environmentVariables.name: INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Instagram access token (Instagram API with Instagram Login).

environmentVariables.name: MESSAGING_MCP_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path of the local message database. Optional.
